propositions: Three independent detached-spawn sites duplicate PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, stdio discipline, and cwd logic across push.py, enrich_drain.py, and compact_trigger.py
Bug 3198 (missing cwd on Popen) propagated identically to all three sites via deliberate copy-paste across separate commits, demonstrating structural risk

A single stdlib-only helper rebar._proc.spawn_detached must consolidate the pattern; callers retain per-site exception handling and env construction but share the bootstrap, detach flags, and durable cwd

Static source scan test must enforce that detached-spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry stub) appear only in _proc.py to prevent fourth copy-paste occurrence
A fourth site gc_trigger.py was discovered during review, landing the same pattern; the helper must be generalized to accept variadic child arguments and gc_trigger must be collapsed onto it
